First of all, I need recipes for all of this! ♥️ Secondly, I'm seeing lots of peeps talking about debilitating pain and fatigue during their periods. Thats not normal! Please talk to your GP about endometriosis & other reproductive disorders! (PCOS and PMDD should be discussed too!) Fatigue is a HUGE 🚩 for endometriosis. I had severe endo, and my fatigue and pain caused me to be bedridden for 1.5 years. If I can spare anyone else the agony I suffered bc my diagnosis took so long (7+ years) its absolutely worth it. Remember, imaging sometimes struggles to show endo- your symptoms are valid no matter what an ultrasound says. Keep pushing for treatment and a diagnosis!
